children: G5 Entertainment AB proposes redeeming up to 1,053,892 ordinary shares, about 14.3% of outstanding ordinary shares, at SEK 80 per share, for a maximum of approximately SEK 84.3M. The proposal requires shareholder approval at a December 22, 2026 meeting.
Proposes redemption of up to SEK 84.3M
Returns surplus capital to shareholders and reduces the share count; the proposal remains subject to shareholder approval.
The proposed scale could materially reduce shares outstanding if shareholders approve and holders participate.
The proposed price is at an approximately 10% premium to the 10-trading-day volume-weighted average price; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Cancellation would remove treasury shares, but the proposal also requires approval at the extraordinary meeting.

This is a capital-return proposal following cost savings implemented during 2026; the company says it is profitable and has a strong financial position. The next catalyst is the December 22, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, where the proposal requires at least two-thirds support of votes cast and shares represented.
